title: Exploring the Intersection of Brain-Computer Interfaces and Quantum Sensing: A Review of Research Progress and Future Trends
summary: Comprehensive peer-reviewed review (2024) of quantum sensing for BCI. Covers OPM-MEG, SQUID-MEG, NV-diamond for neural sensing. Identifies OPM-MEG as the leading near-term quantum BCI approach. Discusses feasibility constraints and future directions. Key reference: confirms the field is recognized but nascent. Does not identify a novel sub-$20k architecture.
bci_relevance: Best existing review of the intersection. Confirms no quantum BCI exists below $20k. OPM-MEG is the technology to beat for independent researcher innovation.
independent_researcher_budget: Review confirms commercial OPM-MEG systems well above $20k per system. Gap opportunity: novel single/few-channel OPM designs with DIY magnetic shielding.
